reviewer_summary.question: Why must a chosen word become a new input, and how can saved reading data at each layer reduce the work?
reviewer_summary.takeaway: Choosing blue uses the earlier word’s finished number; processing blue produces its own number, while separate layer caches let it reuse unchanged earlier keys and values.
